officialText:
Upon issuance of a permit for work containing a tenant protection plan, the department shall make the tenant protection plan publicly available on its website.

(L.L. 2017/154, 8/30/2017, eff. 12/28/2017; Am. L.L. 2019/106, 6/8/2019, eff. 3/8/2020)

Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2017/154.
